scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @workday/contracts && npm run build --workspace @workday/planner && npm run build --workspace @workday/integrations && npm run build --workspace @workday/api && npm run build --workspace @workday/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @workday/api" "npm run dev --workspace @workday/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @workday/contracts && npm run build --workspace @workday/planner && npm run build --workspace @workday/integrations && npm run typecheck --workspace @workday/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @workday/web
